_source: claude-code/src/utils/worktree.ts (branch prefix + path layout + slug validation)
_note: Branch prefix is the literal 'worktree-' (NOT 'lingxi/', NOT 'claude/'). Worktrees live at <repo_root>/.lingxi/worktrees/<flatten_slug(slug)> with '/' flattened to '+'. Slug validation: each '/'-separated segment matches [a-zA-Z0-9._-]+, total length 1..=64. See platforms/posix/src/worktree.rs::validate_worktree_slug and ::flatten_slug.
